digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and RUF rule enforcement
propositions: Enable RUF rule family in global ruff configuration and enforce it via ratchet test to prevent regression

Remediate all 179 actionable RUF diagnostics (RUF059, RUF022, RUF012, RUF005, RUF043, RUF023, RUF007, RUF028, RUF034, RUF019, RUF046, RUF102) across src/rebar and tests using safe mechanical fixes and reviewed unsafe fixes
Defer RUF001, RUF002, RUF003 intentional Unicode symbols in [tool.ruff.lint].ignore with no extend-ignore or per-file RUF exemptions
Validate that per-file-ignores contains no RUF selector or code and that narrow-selection RUF100 artifacts are not treated as actionable debt
Remove 374 stale noqa directives under full configured rule set after RUF is enabled, excluding narrow-selection RUF100 artifacts
